text:
elaine_docs: Opening a short PR to update streaming examples to the resume-friendly flow. Will include compact py/ts/go snippets and a short migration note.

sam_sdk: Nice. Call out retry semantics: runtime expects clients to resend the last acked cursor, not restart.

elaine_docs: Draft Python snippet: `cursor=None
try:
  for patch in client.stream('gpt-mini', prompt):
    handle(patch)
    cursor = patch.cursor
except TransientError:
  client.stream.resume('gpt-mini', cursor)`

nisha_devex: For TS use async iterator and a small `resumeOnError()` helper with backoff/jitter. Add link to batching#idempotency.

matt_pm: Add note about prefix cache / trimming to reduce token echo.

ci-bot: docs-lint reported a broken anchor in guide/streaming.md:line 84.

elaine_docs: Fixed anchor and pushed update. PTAL.

sam_sdk: One nit: Go SDK exposes the field as `ResumeCursor`. Add a tiny language note/table listing field name diffs across SDKs.

elaine_docs: Will add that and a small eval harness snippet for regression checks before merge. Thanks everyone :tada:
